# SWGfL (South West Grid for Learning)

> Multi-award winning educational charity providing comprehensive online safety, safeguarding, security training and tools to empower safe technology use in schools and organisations.

SWGfL is a UK-based charity specializing in child protection and digital safety for educational institutions. They offer training programs, anonymous reporting systems, device monitoring tools, and expert guidance on emerging threats including AI-related harms and intimate image abuse.

## Key Topics

- Online Safety
- Safeguarding
- Child Protection
- Anonymous Reporting
- Digital Wellbeing
- Intimate Image Abuse
- School Security
- GDPR Compliance
- Harmful Sexual Behaviour
- Cyberbullying Prevention
- Filtering & Monitoring
- AI Risks
- Sexting Guidance
- Data Protection

## Core Services & Products

- [Whisper® - Anonymous Reporting Tool](https://swgfl.org.uk/products/whisper): Whisper anonymous reporting tool for schools and youth organizations
- [Test Filtering +](https://swgfl.org.uk/services/test-filtering-plus): Test Filtering+ device monitoring tool for continuous harmful content detection
- [Online Safety Products, Services, and Resources](https://swgfl.org.uk/catalogue): Comprehensive catalog of SWGfL products, services, training, and resources

## Training Programs

- [Essential Training for Schools and Organisations](https://swgfl.org.uk/training): SWGfL training programs covering online safety, security, and safeguarding
- [Essential Online Safety Training](https://swgfl.org.uk/training/online-safety-training): Online safety training for children, educators, parents, and SEND settings

## Guidance & Resources

- [Online Safety for Schools](https://swgfl.org.uk/online-safety): SWGfL online safety resources for schools including training and anonymous reporting
- [Safeguarding in Schools](https://swgfl.org.uk/safeguarding): Safeguarding guidance and tools for schools from SWGfL and partners
- [Security Resources for Schools](https://swgfl.org.uk/security): School security resources covering cybersecurity training, GDPR, and Cyber Essentials
- [Topic: Online Safety and Social Media](https://swgfl.org.uk/topics/social-media): Guidance and resources on social media safety for young people
- [Topic: Digital Wellbeing](https://swgfl.org.uk/topics/digital-wellbeing): Digital wellbeing guidance and resources for schools supporting children's health
